## Summary

[Partial] Drill, tap, run lines from pump to hydraulic ram connecting one end of the ram to the horizontal steering arm and the other to the axle. [t1476]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

2. [Partial] Run two lines from the pump to a hydraulic ram.

## Parts

- [Partial] Hydraulic Ram [t1476]

## Tips & gotchas

- Connect one end of the ram to the horizontal steering arm and the other to the axle. [t1476]
- [Partial] Use flow limiters if necessary to control oil flow so assist does not overpower mechanical linkage. [t1476]
